info.title: FraudKit - Fraud Risk Score for Signups & Orders (Email, IP, Phone, User-Agent)
info.description:
# FraudKit: Fraud Risk Score for Signups and Orders

Stop fake signups, trial abuse and risky orders with one call. FraudKit checks the email, IP address, phone number and user-agent you already collect, cross-checks them against the billing country, and returns a 0-100 risk score with clear reasons and a recommended action.

**Who it's for:** SaaS products fighting trial abuse, e-commerce stores screening orders, marketplaces, fintech onboarding and community platforms.

## Use cases
- Block disposable-email and bot signups before they hit your database.
- Send medium-risk orders to manual review and auto-approve low-risk ones.
- Detect customers ordering through VPNs or data-centre IPs from a different country than their card.
- Require phone or captcha verification only when the score is high.
- Log explainable reasons for every decision for audit and chargeback disputes.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://fraudkit-fraud-risk-score-for-signups-orders.p.rapidapi.com/score?email=jane%40mailinator.com&ip=104.28.1.1&country=GB' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: fraudkit-fraud-risk-score-for-signups-orders.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`fraudkit-fraud-risk-score-for-signups-orders.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- The score is rules-based and fully explainable; every point is listed in `reasons`. Tune your own thresholds if `risk_level` is too strict or lenient for your business.
- Email checks use live DNS; IP, phone and user-agent checks are local and fast.
- FraudKit is a decision aid; combine it with your own business rules.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `422` missing or invalid parameter. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- IP country and network data: DB-IP Lite by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0. Attribution is included in the `signals.ip.attribution` field.
- Phone metadata: Google libphonenumber (phonenumbers library), Apache 2.0.
- User-agent parsing: uap-core regexes via ua-parser, Apache 2.0.
- Disposable-domain, VPN and hosting-provider lists are maintained in-house.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.summary: Score the fraud risk of a signup or order
get.description:
Combines up to five signals into one explainable 0-100 risk score with a level, a recommended action and plain-English reasons: email quality (syntax, MX, disposable, role, typo), IP network (VPN/proxy, hosting, country), phone validity and line type, user-agent bot detection, and consistency with the billing country. Send at least one of email, ip, phone or user_agent; more signals give a better score.

**Scoring weights:** disposable email +40, invalid email +35, risky email +15, role account +5; VPN/proxy IP +30, hosting/datacenter IP +25, private IP +10, IP country differs from billing country +15; invalid phone +25, VoIP/premium/shared-cost/personal line +15, phone country differs from billing country +10 (or from IP country +5); bot or automation user-agent +30, unrecognised browser +10. GG, JE and IM count as GB for country matching.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Customer email address (max 254 characters read). URL-encode `+` as `%2B`.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Customer IPv4 or IPv6 address. An invalid IP returns 422.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Customer phone number, E.164 (URL-encode `+` as `%2B`) or national format; national numbers are read using `country`, else the IP's country.

parameters.name: user_agent
parameters.description: Browser User-Agent string from the customer's request (max 1000 characters read). `ua` is accepted as an alias.
parameters.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Billing or declared country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Enables country-mismatch checks.

reasons: IP is in a hosting/datacenter network
IP country CA differs from billing country GB
phone country GG differs from IP country CA
user-agent is a bot or automation tool

ip.attribution: IP geolocation by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0

422.description: No signal supplied, or the IP is invalid.

example.error: Provide at least one of: email, ip, phone, user_agent

get.summary: Parse a user-agent and detect bots
get.description: Parses a User-Agent string into browser, version, OS, device and brand, and flags mobile devices and bots (crawlers, headless browsers, automation frameworks and HTTP libraries).

parameters.name: ua
parameters.description: User-Agent string to parse (max 1000 characters read). `user_agent` is accepted as an alias. If omitted, the User-Agent header of this request is parsed.
parameters.example: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1

example.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1

get.summary: Check for a disposable email domain
get.description: Fast check of whether a domain (or the domain of an email address) belongs to a known disposable or temporary inbox provider such as mailinator.com or yopmail.com. No DNS lookup is made.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain to check, or a full email address (the part after @ is used). Provide this or `email`.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Alternative to `domain`: an email address whose domain is checked.

example.error: domain or email query parameter is required

post.summary: MCP server (FraudKit tools for AI agents)

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

risk_score.description: 0 (no risk signals) to 100 (capped). Sum of the weights of triggered signals.

recommendation.description: Suggested action for the risk level.

reasons.description: Human-readable reason for every signal that added risk, in evaluation order.

signals.description: Raw results for each input you supplied (keys appear only for supplied inputs).

IpSignal.description: IP signal (country-level geolocation and network). For non-public IPs only the flags plus `country: null` and `asn: null` are present.

attribution.description: Data attribution required by the IP data licence.

PhoneSignal.description: Phone signal. Unparseable input yields only `input`, `valid`, `possible` and `error`.

line_type.description: Line type, e.g. mobile, fixed_line, voip.

browser.description: Browser or client family, 'Other' if unknown.

is_bot.description: Crawler, headless browser, automation tool or HTTP library (curl, python-requests, Puppeteer and so on).

disposable.description: Domain is a known disposable provider.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the request did not arrive through the RapidAPI gateway, or your RapidAPI key is not subscribed to this API.

example.message: You are not subscribed to this API.

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable: a required parameter is missing or a value is invalid. The `error` text says which.

example.error: A required parameter is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.

example.message: You have exceeded the rate limit per second for your plan, BASIC, by the API provider

RapidAPIKey.name: X-RapidAPI-Key
RapidAPIKey.description: Your RapidAPI key. Also send header X-RapidAPI-Host: fraudkit-fraud-risk-score-for-signups-orders.p.rapidapi.com
